noticias.titular: Astros frustrated by boos from sparse crowd during wild-card opener
noticias.texto: Astros players were "extremely frustrated" at opening the playoffs in front of a sparse crowd that showered boos on the home team during a 6-3 loss to the White Sox.

noticias.titular: White Sox top Astros in Game 1; first playoff win in 5 years
noticias.texto: The White Sox beat the Astros 6-3 in Game 1 of their AL Wild Card Series, the club's first playoff win since 2021.

noticias.titular: Mattingly's call to Duran in 7th backfires in Phillies' loss
noticias.texto: Don Mattingly wanted the Phillies' best reliever on the mound as early as possible in the opener of a best-of-three NL Wild Card Series against the Braves, but the move backfired when All-Star closer Jhoan Duran allowed a three-run homer in a Game 1 loss.

noticias.titular: Pope Leo XIV sends blessings to White Sox ahead of playoffs
noticias.texto: The White Sox got a letter of support from Pope Leo XIV, a longtime fan and Chicago native, prior to Tuesday's playoff opener vs. the Astros.

noticias.titular: Riley's homer rallies Braves past Phillies in wild-card opener
noticias.texto: Austin Riley hit a three-run homer off All-Star closer Jhoan Duran in the eighth inning, and the Braves rallied past the Phillies 5-3 on Tuesday in the opener their National League Wild Card Series.
